gaps.sentence: The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The soup is a ___ (MIX) of herbs and spices.
gaps.explanation: 'A mixture of' — the noun for a blend.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.
